expectations.text: A Hero component is created under components/shared/ (marketing/ or layout/)
Markup is semantic: a <section> wrapper and a real <a>/<button> CTA, not div soup
Not pinned to fixed desktop px (no w-[1100px] / text-[56px] hardcodes) — responsive utilities used
expectations.evidence: Hardcodes text-[56px] and max-w-[1100px] — pinned to desktop px, not responsive.

expectations.text: The gradient is a theme token/utility, not an inline style with raw hex
expectations.evidence: Uses from-blue-500 to-purple-600 (default Tailwind palette), not the brand gradient token.

expectations.text: A typed props interface (heading/subheading/CTA) is defined

expectations.evidence: Registry has a Hero row at components/shared/marketing/hero.tsx.
